description: This file implements Azure AI OCR transformation logic, including configuration, URL-to-data URI conversion (both sync and async), environment validation, and request transformation specific to Azure AI's OCR API.

classes.name: AzureAIOCRConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Azure AI OCR transformation, inheriting from MistralOCRConfig, handling environment validation and URL conversion for OCR requests.

methods.name: Dict validate_environment( self, headers: Dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, litellm_params: Optional[dict] = None, **kwargs, )

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: Optional[dict] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete API endpoint URL for Azure AI OCR service.

methods.name: str _convert_url_to_data_uri_sync(self, url: str)
methods.description: Synchronously converts a URL to a base64 data URI using existing utility.

methods.name: str _convert_url_to_data_uri_async(self, url: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously converts a URL to a base64 data URI using the async utility.

methods.name: OCRRequestData transform_ocr_request( self, model: str, document: DocumentType, optional_params: dict, headers: dict, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Transforms OCR request data, converting URL-based document/image fields into base64 data URIs (sync version).

methods.name: OCRRequestData async_transform_ocr_request( self, model: str, document: DocumentType, optional_params: dict, headers: dict, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Asynchronous version of OCR request transformation, converting URL fields to base64 data URIs.
